description: Tool-call arguments do not stream, so a finished response is checked too: a write that breaks a stream rule is dropped before it runs, and the model answers again with the rule in view.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[[stream_rules]]
name = "box-leak"
pattern = 'Box::leak'
rule = "Do not use Box::leak; use Arc<str> or an owned String."

script.text: I will keep an Arc<str> instead of leaking.
